already_done.text: Initial desk note based on the agency report already circulated.

assumptions.text: Holiday-season sales will be roughly flat year over year.
Liquidity is adequate through Q1 of next year.

constraints.text: The portfolio must not use leverage: no margin, no leveraged funds or ETFs, no leveraged derivatives exposure.
No new purchases of a name while it is on the watchlist.

decisions.rationale: Based on the agency's 3.1x leverage figure.
decisions.text: Consider adding to the position on price dips.

decisions.rationale: Filing-based leverage of 4.2x changes the risk picture; no reason to sell into an unconfirmed report, no basis to add.
decisions.text: Hold the existing Harborline position; do not add.

decisions.rationale: Leverage higher than the agency figure and an unresolved covenant report warrant monitoring status.
The 10-Q is the primary source and includes operating leases; the agency figure excludes them.
decisions.text: Use the filing-based 4.2x leverage figure as authoritative for internal risk decisions.

evidence.text: Rating agency reports leverage of 3.1x, outlook stable, excluding operating leases.
The 10-Q implies leverage of 4.2x including operating leases; it contains no mention of a covenant breach.

evidence.source: financial news article (unconfirmed, denied by the company)
evidence.text: A news article claims a possible covenant breach, citing unnamed sources; the company denies it; no filing or lender statement confirms it.
Cash and revolver availability cover maturities through Q1 of next year.

must_not_state.text: Harborline breached a debt covenant (as an established fact).
The authoritative internal leverage figure is 3.1x.
The current recommendation is to add to the position.

next_actions.text: Reassess after holiday-season sales are reported.
Seek confirmation or denial of the covenant report from a filing or lender statement, not press coverage.

objective: Review the Harborline Retail bond position under conflicting sources and correct the internal leverage figure.

open_questions.text: Is there any actual covenant breach? Unconfirmed by any primary source.
How will holiday-season sales land? Not yet reported.

revision_chains.what_changed: The internal leverage figure was corrected from 3.1x to 4.2x
revision_chains.why: Reading the primary filing showed the agency figure excludes operating leases; on a like-for-like basis leverage is 4.2x

revision_chains.revised: Hold the position, do not add
revision_chains.what_changed: The position stance reversed from consider-adding to hold-no-add
revision_chains.why: Corrected leverage of 4.2x and watchlist placement changed the risk assessment
